description: Package manager for LSP servers, formatters, linters, and DAP servers. Provides a UI for installing and managing external tools.
author: williamboman
tagline: Portable package manager for LSP servers, formatters & linters

options.label: PATH Handling
options.description: How Mason adds its bin directory to your system PATH. 'prepend' puts Mason tools first (recommended), 'append' puts them last, 'skip' doesn't modify PATH.

options.label: Max Concurrent Installers
options.description: Maximum number of packages to install at the same time.

options.label: Log Level
options.description: Controls how much detail is written to Mason's log file.

options.label: Registries
options.description: Package registries to source packages from. The default mason-org registry contains most popular tools.

options.label: Check Outdated on Open
options.description: Automatically check for new versions when opening the :Mason window.

options.label: Window Border
options.description: Border style for the Mason floating window.

options.label: Window Width
options.description: Width of the Mason window. Use a decimal between 0-1 for percentage of screen width (e.g., 0.8 = 80%), or an integer > 1 for fixed columns.

options.label: Window Height
options.description: Height of the Mason window. Use a decimal between 0-1 for percentage of screen height, or an integer > 1 for fixed rows.

options.label: Installed Icon
options.description: Icon shown next to installed packages.

options.label: Pending Icon
options.description: Icon shown next to packages being installed.

options.label: Uninstalled Icon
options.description: Icon shown next to uninstalled packages.

options.label: Upgrade pip
options.description: Upgrade pip to the latest version in Python virtual environments created by Mason.

options.label: pip Install Arguments
options.description: Extra arguments to pass to 'pip install' when installing Python-based tools.

options.label: GitHub Download URL Template
options.description: URL template for downloading releases from GitHub. Useful for GitHub Enterprise or mirror setups. Uses %s placeholders for owner/repo, tag, and asset name.

functions.name: open
functions.label: Open Mason UI
functions.whatItDoes: Opens the Mason graphical interface where you can browse, install, update, and remove LSP servers, formatters, and linters.

functions.name: install
functions.label: Install Package
functions.whatItDoes: Installs a Mason-managed tool (LSP server, formatter, linter, etc.) by its package name.

functions.name: uninstall
functions.label: Uninstall Package
functions.whatItDoes: Removes a Mason-managed tool from your system.

functions.name: update
functions.label: Update Registries
functions.description: Update all managed registries to refresh available package info
functions.whatItDoes: Refreshes Mason's package registry to fetch the latest available versions and newly added packages.

exCommands.name: Mason
exCommands.description: Open the Mason graphical status window to browse, install, uninstall, and update packages.

exCommands.name: MasonInstall
exCommands.description: Install one or more packages by name. Supports version pinning with @version syntax (e.g., rust-analyzer@nightly).

params.name: package
params.description: Package name(s) to install. Supports version pinning with @version.

exCommands.name: MasonUpdate
exCommands.description: Update all managed registries. This refreshes the list of available packages and their versions, but does not update installed packages themselves.

exCommands.name: MasonUninstall
exCommands.description: Uninstall one or more Mason packages by name.

exCommands.name: MasonLog
exCommands.description: Open the Mason log file in a new tab window. Useful for debugging package installation issues.
